newsitem.title: USA: Arco says to carry 100 pct of Line 63 crude.
newsitem.headline: Arco says to carry 100 pct of Line 63 crude.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co. (ARCO) said Tuesday its California Line 63 pipeline will carry 100 percent of crude nominated by shippers for April delivery.
"The April line will not be in proration," said an ARCO spokesman, referring to the many months of below-capacity deliveries since a 1994 earthquake limited capacity.
The company, citing policy, declined to give the line's daily througput for April, but said it typically runs between 100,000 and 110,000 barrels-per-day (bpd).
